notes.title: v0.5.4
notes.content:
Minor update!

Fixed Desktop icon not appearing correctly
Fixed issue with colliders in a few known locations
Fixed issue with a hidden achievement not working (Titled: "What does it Mean?!")
Added new interaction with players who make it to hour 4 and beyond!
Made some tweaks to some random events
Starting balancing some of the hours: focus for today is hour 4

notes.title: Update v0.5.3
notes.content:
Small Changes to some Cutscenes!

Improved Audio Quality of Hour 4
Improved Audio Quality of Hour 5


Also Added a new desktop icon!

notes.title: Update v0.5.2
notes.content:
Changes to include Audio fixes!

Fixed missing clock sound (Should help guide back to main clock)
Added more ambience background sounds
Added random rotation through background sounds
Changed quality of a few sfx to improve atmosphere


Added more achievements!

A few hidden achievements, honoring a few of our game testers!
Hint: Try to decipher some of the words of wisdom
Hint: It may be the first hour, but you are still vulnerable
Hint: Don't stop running


Re-implemented Random events
Secret events now happen, here are some clues:

Clue: Your flashlight might not work like it used to...
Clue: You might not be able to trust what you hear...
Clue: You might not be able to trust what you see...

notes.title: Update 0.5.1
notes.content:
[olist]
Added Random scary events! 
Improvements to sound quality!
Hidden Achievement is now attainable! Good luck finding it...
A few bug fixes...
[/olist]

notes.title: New Update - Finishing Touches!
notes.content:
Added more lore and story to the game!

Cutscene for completing Hour 4 was added!
Cutscene for completing Hour 5 was added!
A few more hidden items added to the game!


Achievements were added!

Achievements for completing hours 1-5
Achievement for completing the extreme hour 6
A hidden achievement was added...


Other improvements!

Some sound issues were fixed
Order of the game and hours were changed
Credits were changed to reflect those who helped put this game together


We hear your feedback and want to add more, stay tuned as we endeavor to improve on our first game!
